layer2_pixels.measured_in: one process (CPU); both compositions executed here
layer2_pixels.adapter_composition: the adapter worker's own targetpad_transform(1.25, 224) call
layer2_pixels.adapter_decode_by: workbench.composition.model_hint (targetpad_transform(1.25, 224), the same call the worker makes at model_hint.py:329)

cache_off_restart.why: the adapter asserts one worker load per instance (`model_tgcir.py:344 _check_worker_pid` -> `adapter_worker_reloaded`), so an in-process restart is refused by construction
cache_off_restart.consequence: a same-process restart comparison is ABSENT for this model; it is not reported as equal

population.why: the fixed sample only: a PREVIEW, so any verdict about this dimension is about the sample and the dimension stays INCOMPLETE for the population

scoring_ranking.reference_mask: the native protocol's reference mask is applied by the adapter's own rank() call; the native RANK MEASUREMENT was not available

native_rank_control_absent.why: no stored native per-query-rank measurement exists for this model, so the adapter's ranks cannot be compared against a native MEASUREMENT
native_rank_control_absent.consequence: `metrics_parity` is reported `missing`, which is INCOMPLETE and never a pass. `scoring_parity` IS measured, on the comparison below

rank_comparison.right: numpy argsort(-sims) UNMASKED, applied to the SAME adapter features (`test.py:141-152` convention minus the reference mask, which this adapter does not apply)
rank_comparison.why_this_is_not_a_self_comparison: two different implementations of the ranking over one feature array: the adapter's own score/rank code, and the pinned evaluator's convention

adapter_production_recall_informational.note: the adapter's own ranking of its own features. INFORMATION, not a parity comparison: with no native control there is nothing to compare it to

component_parity.chunk_rule: full when components_total <= 4096, else every component in chunks of at most 4096: the chunks tile [0, components_total) with no gap and no overlap, so the coverage is complete at any size
